name: Bride of the Embalmer
summary: In Darkshire, Lord Ello Ebonlocke sends you to find Eliza's grave. The town has learned that the Embalmer is real, and you are to take his living heart from her cursed remains to strip him of his power.

sections.title: A Bedtime Story Come Alive
sections.body: Duskwood's children grew up hearing a tale of the Embalmer. He was said to be a kindly alchemist, driven mad when his beloved wife, Eliza, died. Desperate to cheat death, he turned to sorcery, cut out his own beating heart, and placed it in her chest. Lord Ello Ebonlocke once dismissed the story as village folklore. Recent discoveries have shown that the Embalmer walks among the living, and his work festers beneath the graveyard dirt.

sections.title: The Resurrected Bride
sections.body: Eliza's return to life came at a terrible cost. The stolen spark revived her as a ravenous abomination, hungry without end for living human flesh. Horrified by what he had made and unwilling to destroy her, the Embalmer hid his bride in a lonely grave. He visited her in secret while plotting further wicked deeds. Lord Ebonlocke now sends you to uncover Eliza's grave, kill the flesh hungry horror, and take the still beating heart that sustains the Embalmer's dark art.

sections.title: Darkshire's Aegis
sections.body: When you bring Eliza's beating heart back to Darkshire, Lord Ebonlocke is relieved. The mayor does not mean to destroy it. He intends to turn the alchemist's craft against him, using the eldritch magic within the heart as a defensive talisman and aegis over Darkshire. He hopes it will shield the beleaguered town from whatever wrath the weakened Embalmer can still summon in vengeance.

faq.answer: The Embalmer was an alchemist in Duskwood who went mad after his wife, Eliza, died. He turned to necromancy, cut out his living heart, and placed it in her corpse to revive her, becoming an elusive monster.

faq.q: Why was Eliza buried if she was brought back to life?
aliases: why keep eliza in a grave
faq.answer: The alchemist revived Eliza with his own heart, but the dark magic made her ravenous for living human flesh. Unable to return her safely to society or satisfy her feral hunger, he hid her in a cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Lord Ebonlocke want the Embalmer's Heart?
faq.answer: Ello believes the Embalmer's heart is the source of his power. He asks you to take it from Eliza's grave while it still beats, believing that will break the alchemist's power.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to get bride of the embalmer
faq.answer: The chain follows directly from 'Translation to Ello'. The old letters and research delivered to Lord Ello Ebonlocke prove that the Embalmer from local nursery tales is active and dangerous.

faq.q: Does retrieving the heart defeat the Embalmer permanently?
faq.answer: Ello believes taking the heart will break the Embalmer's power. What follows becomes clear when you return to Darkshire.

aliases: who starts bride of the embalmer
faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke, Darkshire's mayor and leader, gives you this charge at the Darkshire Town Hall after learning the truth behind the town's folklore.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see Eliza's foul reanimation as an affront to the Light and natural law. You can purge the flesh eating horror and sever the necromancer's blasphemous lifeline.
As a priest, you can recognize the grieving widower's tragedy while knowing that Eliza's flesh hungry mockery of life must be laid to rest with holy finality.
With the Night Watch stretched thin against Duskwood's feral terrors, you must step in as an Alliance champion to defend Darkshire from this ancient, creeping madness.
